name: live_mcp_capabilities
description:
Inspect local MCP tools and command schemas without connecting to KiCad.

This inventory describes the loaded adapter, not negotiated support in a live
editor. Document availability, command support and undo behavior still depend
on the connected KiCad version and editor.

name: live_schematic_documents
description: List open live schematic documents and KiCad version. Requires development KiCad 10.99/11+.

name: live_schematic_hierarchy
description: Read the live hierarchy, including unsaved child sheets. Use UUID sheet paths to target instances.

name: live_schematic_items
description:
Read unsaved items on one sheet as protobuf JSON. Positions are nanometers (1 mm = 1000000 nm).

Preserve the returned @type and all fields when updating an item. SheetSymbol includes its pins.

name: live_document_revision
description:
Read an open document's live revision (schematic, board, symbol or footprint document).

The editor advances it on every change: manual edits, API edits, undo/redo, reloads. Pass it as
expected_revision to an edit so KiCad refuses the edit if anything changed in between. Also
reports open API commits (from any client) and unsaved changes.

name: live_operation_status
description:
After a timed-out or uncertain edit: ask KiCad what happened to it. Never resends anything.

state: OPS_COMMITTED, OPS_ROLLED_BACK (dropped, conflicting or abandoned; nothing applied),
OPS_REJECTED (refused before changing anything), OPS_IN_PROGRESS (its commit is still open;
ask again), OPS_FAILED (an error after it may have changed the document; inspect it) or
OPS_UNKNOWN (not received yet, or older than the last history_capacity operations).
Do not resend an edit while its outcome is unknown.

name: live_schematic_create_items
description:
Create up to 200 items in the live editor as one undo step, without saving.

Each item is protobuf JSON with @type=type.googleapis.com/kiapi.schematic.types.TYPE.
Types include SchematicLine, HierarchicalLabel, Junction, SheetSymbol and SchematicText.
Use live_schematic_item_schema for field definitions. Coordinates are nanometers.
New sheets need a unique filename_field, name_field, size, position and page_number;
set visible=true on name_field and filename_field (otherwise the sheet is drawn unlabeled)
and fields_autoplaced=true so KiCad positions them at the sheet border.
Pins belong in SheetSymbol.pins, positioned on the sheet edge given by side.
Use live_schematic_place_symbol for library symbols.

name: live_schematic_update_items
description:
Replace live items in one undo step without saving. Supply complete items from live_schematic_items.

Preserve IDs and unrelated fields; omitted fields are not a partial update. To add sheet pins,
modify the parent SheetSymbol.pins and return its complete item. Hierarchical labels must match.

name: live_schematic_delete_items
description: Delete the specified UUIDs on one live sheet as one undo step, without saving.

name: live_schematic_list_commands
description:
List every KiCad IPC command these tools know (schematic, PCB, libraries), its kind
(read/edit/view/file/job) and reply type.

name: live_schematic_describe_command
description: Show the fields of a command from live_schematic_list_commands, for use with execute or batch.

name: live_schematic_execute
description:
Run any KiCad IPC command (schematic or PCB) by name with a protobuf-JSON payload.

Prefer the typed tools. Most commands need a document (or header.document) from
live_schematic_documents. File-kind commands (SaveDocument, RevertDocument, ...) change or discard
files: run them only when the user asks. An edit command is not retried if the reply is lost:
it carries an operation id for live_operation_status. expected_revision applies to document edits.

name: live_schematic_batch
description:
Run supported item edits as ONE undo step; failed steps roll back those item edits.

document_spec is a schematic, board (DOCTYPE_PCB), symbol or footprint document.

steps: [{"command": "CreateItems", "payload": {...}}, ...] using names from live_schematic_list_commands.
Only edits marked batchable participate in rollback; settings, editor replacement,
asynchronous work, undo/redo and file/job commands are refused. Omitted document
targets inherit this batch's document; explicit targets must match it exactly.
Selection and zoom changes are not rolled back. With expected_revision, KiCad also rolls the
batch back if anyone else changes the document while it runs.

name: live_schematic_item_schema
description:
Describe a schematic protobuf item and nested fields, including enum choices.

Start with SheetSymbol, SheetPin, HierarchicalLabel or SchematicLine. Use returned message names
in further calls. Protobuf JSON uses snake_case fields here and UUIDs as {value: UUID}.

name: live_pcb_item_schema
description:
Describe a board protobuf type and its fields (Track, Via, Arc, Zone, BoardGraphicShape, BoardText,
FootprintInstance, Pad, ...), including enum choices.

name: live_pcb_documents
description: List boards open in the PCB editor (board documents for the live_pcb_* tools).

name: live_schematic_export
description:
Export the unsaved schematic as svg, pdf, dxf, ps, netlist or bom to a path KiCad can write.

The bom is orderable by default: CSV, one line per part grouped by Value, Footprint,
Manufacturer and MPN, every reference listed, DNP parts left out (columns Reference, Qty, Value,
Footprint, Manufacturer, MPN, Alt Manufacturer, Alt MPN, Description, Datasheet). options is
protobuf JSON of the kind's RunSchematicJobExport* message (live_schematic_describe_command),
merged over the defaults; a list replaces the default list, e.g. {"exclude_dnp": false} or
{"fields": {"fields": [{"name": "Reference", "label": "Ref"}]}}. job_settings is not accepted.
Warnings KiCad logged while exporting are returned in message.

name: live_pcb_export
description:
Export from the live board (unsaved edits included) to a folder or file KiCad can write.

kind: gerbers | drill | position | step | pdf | svg | dxf | ipc2581 | ipcd356 | odb | stats | dsn |
gencad | idf. Gerbers and drill take an output folder. options is protobuf JSON of the kind's
RunBoardJobExport* message (live_schematic_describe_command), merged over the defaults; a list
replaces the default list. Examples: drill {"units": "U_MM", "map_format": "DMF_PDF",
"excellon": {"combine_pth_npth": false}}; position {"format": "PF_CSV", "side": "PS_BOTH",
"single_file": true, "exclude_dnp": true}; pdf {"plot_settings": {"layers": ["BL_F_Fab",
"BL_Edge_Cuts"]}}; step {"format": "B3D_GLB"}; ipc2581 {"manufacturer_part_number_column":
"MPN"}. job_settings is not accepted. message carries warnings KiCad logged while exporting
(check outputs: a STEP export of a malformed outline warns and writes nothing). For a complete
fab and assembly set use live_pcb_fab_package.

name: live_pcb_fab_package
description:
Build the manufacturing package: check the design, export every fab and assembly output, check
what was written, and write a manifest and a zip of the Gerbers folder.

output_dir defaults to <project>/Outputs. Folders: Gerbers (X2 Gerbers of every copper layer,
mask, paste, silkscreen and Edge.Cuts with a job file; Excellon drill in mm with separate
PTH/NPTH, drill map PDF and drill report), PnP (<project>-pos.csv:
CSV, mm, both sides, DNP left out), STEP, Assembly (fab layers PDF, one page per side), BOM
(orderable CSV as live_schematic_export bom), Schematic (PDF); optional IPC-2581 (with MPN and
Manufacturer), ODB (zip) and Netlist (IPC-D-356). outputs selects from gerbers, drill, position,
step, assembly_pdf, ipc2581, odb, ipcd356, bom, schematic_pdf (default: all but ipc2581, odb
and ipcd356). options maps an output to protobuf JSON merged over its default (as for
live_pcb_export). Files come from the absolute board origin.

Before exporting: the board (and schematic, for bom/schematic_pdf; the project's open schematic
unless schematic_document is given) must be saved unless allow_unsaved, and with checks DRC
with schematic parity must report no errors (zones must be filled). A blocked package returns
exported=false with blocked_by (unsaved or drc) and writes nothing. Existing outputs are
replaced only with overwrite. After exporting, verification reports the plotted copper layers
against the board, drill holes, placements per side, BOM lines, parts without an MPN and parts
in the BOM without a placement; warnings lists these and KiCad's own export warnings, what a fab
or assembler would query.
